claim.value: Missing log entries must remain unknown when reconstructing bookings.
claim.scope: Linking the 74 bookings to equipment and booking logs during days 1–3.

provenance.rationale: P003 explicitly requires preserving missing entries as unknown during this reconstruction.

signal_basis.value: Bookings are reconstructed by linking separate logs while preserving missing or conflicting entries as unknown. The observed reduction pattern is repeated lateness in a smaller configuration, with specified further removals ceasing to reproduce lateness.
signal_basis.scope: Reconstruction of the 74 bookings and reduction tests of the selected late case.

provenance.rationale: P003 supplies the reconstruction operation and missing-data treatment; P018 supplies the observed pattern; P006 identifies the selected replay case.
The supported procedural claim requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The claim is warranted as an uncertainty-preserving reconstruction rule. Missing records supply no observed values, and reproducing lateness in reduction tests does not recover those missing historical values.
uncertainty: The missing values remain unknown; that uncertainty does not undermine the warrant for recording them as unknown.
